name: Tm Visualization Suite: Comparison Charts
pitch: Compare categories, stages, ranges, and ranks with five chart types on one data setup.
question: How do values differ across categories, between two points, or across stages?
useWhen: Compare categories, stages, ranges, or ranks in one view.
features: Show the change between two measures for each category in a dumbbell.
Compare one value across many categories in a sorted dot plot.
Add a stem to the baseline to draw a lollipop.
Draw a range from minimum to maximum with actual and target markers.
Compare values between stages with a slopegraph.
Follow the rank of each category across stages with a bump chart.

hero.alt: Dumbbell chart of store sales for two fiscal years, with a connector between the two dots.

screenshots.alt: Cleveland dot plot of shrinkage percent for 48 stores, sorted from the highest value.
screenshots.caption: Compare one value across many categories.

screenshots.alt: Bump chart of nine departments across twelve quarters, with one line for each rank.
screenshots.caption: Follow rank changes across stages.
